forum.title: STM32CubeIDE version 2.1.0 won't generate IOC project file
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Geoff104

In the latest release , STM32CubeMX is no more integrated in STM32CubeIDE 2.0.0  and STM32CubeIDE 2.1.0

For more details , please check this [STM32CubeIDE 2.0.0 released](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubeide-mcus/stm32cubeide-2-0-0-released/td-p/857110)

To download CubeMX standalone please use this [LINK](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

See: [*STM32CubeIDE 2.0.0 New workflow tutorial*](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/stm32cubeide-2-0-0-workflow-tutorial/ta-p/864831 "STM32CubeIDE 2.0.0 workflow tutorial")

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I have recently upodated STM32CubeIDE and have found that starting a new project doesn't generate a \*.ioc file. I found a forum thread dated 7/2025 to a similar issue in versions 1.17-1.19 but the suggested work around menu options don't appear to be in v2.1.0. Any ideas?

this is really annoying as I've got a 'journey to complet'e but I'm wasting my time getting the 'car to start'....
